events.title: Greenrise at Steam Next Fest
events.summary: Update, August 2026: the demo is out now. You do not have to wait for October.Hello World! Greenrise is taking part in the next Steam Next Fest, in October, and the demo is already playable. Prepare yourselves to chop wood, break stones and mine gold. A vast upgrade tree lets you grow your island from a single tile into something far larger.Gear up with distinct main weapons that assist you on your journey and add strategic depth.Wishlist now and follow to stay up to date!
